# google-ai-history-mcp (Google AI & Gemini Chat History Importer for Google Antigravity & MCP)

> Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI sync engine that imports, syncs, indexes (SQLite FTS5), and fetches live URLs from all Google AI conversations and interactions into local Markdown files and MCP tools for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Gemini CLI.

## Core Concept & Why It Is Useful
1. **Drop a URL & Continue / Build a Project Instantly**: Paste any URL from `gemini.google.com/app/...`, `gemini.google.com/share/...`, `google.com/search?udm=50...` (AI Mode), `aistudio.google.com/prompts/...`, or `notebooklm.google.com/notebook/...` directly into **Google Antigravity** and say *"Continue this chat"*, *"Build a project from this"*, or *"Start a project from this session"*. The `fetch_google_ai_chat_url` tool pulls the entire conversation transcript into Antigravity immediately.
2. **Graduate "Small One-Off Chats" into Full Agentic Projects**: Often an idea starts as a quick search in Google AI Overview -> *"Show more"* -> *"Ask anything"* (AI Mode), a casual brainstorm on `gemini.google.com`, or a prompt test in Google AI Studio. When that small idea grows into a real software project, you can roll the entire chat thread straight into Antigravity without copy-pasting or starting over.
3. **New to Antigravity? Bring Your Entire Google AI Brain With You**: Users adopting Google Antigravity can import months or years of prior prompts, code snippets, architectural decisions, and research from across the Google AI ecosystem into a local SQLite FTS5 database (`~/.gemini/google_ai_history/chats.db`) and Markdown folder (`~/.gemini/google_ai_history/markdown/*.md`).

## Supported Google AI Surfaces
1. **Central Google My Activity Hub (`myactivity.google.com`)**: Unified chronological log of Gemini Apps, Search AI Mode, Circle to Search, Google Lens, Ask Maps, YouTube AI, and Assistant.
2. **Gemini Web App (`gemini.google.com/app` & `gemini.google.com/share`)**: Multi-turn consumer chat threads and shared links.
3. **Google Search "AI Mode" & AI Overviews (`google.com/search?udm=50`)**: Conversational search threads started by clicking "Show more" on an AI Overview and using "Ask anything" in AI Mode.
4. **Google AI Studio (`aistudio.google.com`)**: Developer prompts, system instructions, thinking traces, and chat histories saved in `Google Drive/Google AI Studio/` and `aistudio.google.com/library`.
5. **NotebookLM (`notebooklm.google.com`)**: Research notebooks, source summaries, and Q&A notes.

## MCP Tools
- `fetch_google_ai_chat_url(url, login_timeout_sec=45)`: Pulls any single Google AI chat/session directly from a URL so you can continue the chat or build a project from it in Antigravity.
- `get_google_ai_chat(chat_id, login_timeout_sec=45)`: Retrieves a conversation by local ID, title, or live URL.
- `search_google_ai_chats(query, limit=20)`: Full-text SQLite FTS5 search across all synced Google AI chats.
- `list_google_ai_chats(limit=50, offset=0, source=None)`: Lists locally indexed Google AI conversations.
- `sync_google_ai_chats_from_browser(target, max_chats=50, login_timeout_sec=180)`: Bulk syncs `'all'`, `'myactivity'`, `'gemini'`, `'aimode'`, `'aistudio'`, or `'notebooklm'` via Chrome CDP.
- `import_google_ai_takeout_or_files(path)`: Imports Google Takeout archives, Google Drive `Google AI Studio` folders, or JSON/Markdown exports.

## System Requirements & Operational Rules for AI Agents
- **Prerequisites**: Requires Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge installed locally, `uv`, and Python 3.11+.
- **First-Run Chrome Profile Behavior**: Because Chrome v136+ blocks `--remote-debugging-port` on the default Chrome profile, this server launches a dedicated persistent profile at `~/.gemini/google_ai_history/chrome_profile` on port `9222`. On the very first run, it opens a visible Chrome window and auto-clicks "Sign in" so the user can authenticate once; after login, it automatically re-navigates to the requested URL and extracts all turns. All subsequent runs reuse that saved session automatically.
- **Agent Rule (Use MCP Tools, Not Shell `run_command`)**: AI agents MUST call the MCP tools (`fetch_google_ai_chat_url`, `get_google_ai_chat`, `sync_google_ai_chats_from_browser`) rather than invoking the CLI via a sandboxed shell command (`run_command`). On Windows, sandboxed shell commands run on an isolated hidden desktop (`WinSta0\exebox-...`) where the user cannot see the Chrome window, whereas MCP tools execute on the user's interactive desktop (`WinSta0\Default`).
